scripts.build: npm run build -w @industrial-label/core && npm run build -w @industrial-label/api && npm run build -w @industrial-label/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @industrial-label/core && npm run build -w @industrial-label/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @industrial-label/core && npm run build -w @industrial-label/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @industrial-label/core && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @industrial-label/api" "npm run dev -w @industrial-label/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @industrial-label/core && npm run typecheck -w @industrial-label/api && npm run typecheck -w @industrial-label/web
